assets.name: level10-starcore
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production background panorama for the tenth stage of a side-scrolling 2.5D stickman action game, "Star Ring Core".
Input image 1 is style reference only: keep its painterly game environment detail, atmospheric depth, dark readable foreground and polished cinematic lighting. Generate a NEW single panorama, NOT an atlas.
Scene: inside a colossal orbital command station high above a violet planet. Huge interlocking broken metallic orbital rings and a distant suspended reactor core, concentric arc structures, floating maintenance pylons, slender gantries in successive distant layers, starlit space seen through a gigantic fractured observation aperture. Blue-violet nebula far away, cyan-white reactor light, small pale-gold metal accents, smoky violet atmospheric depth. Architectural sci-fi, not fantasy castle. Three clear depth planes, distant rings soft and luminous, middle columns sharp, subtle dark foreground silhouettes at bottom corners.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, side-on camera used for a horizontal platform game. Large quiet readable central/lower combat area; structures belong to the background, no large blocking objects across the middle. Bottom 18 percent mostly dark open atmosphere, not a prominent foreground walkway; actual gameplay platforms are rendered separately. Asymmetric ring silhouettes and layered lighting, believable dimensional volume. Beautiful hand-painted 2.5D game art matching the supplied reference.
Constraints: only one environment image, no panels, no character, no enemy, no HUD, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. No music-related imagery.

assets.name: astral-regent
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production transparent 4 by 4 sprite animation sheet for a NEW tenth-stage armored stickman boss, Astral Regent, in a side-scrolling 2.5D action game.
Input image 1 is style reference only for material shading, stylized stickman silhouette and four-by-four animation layout. Design a NEW distinct boss rather than recoloring that character.
Character: "Astral Regent, Orbital Arbiter". Preserve a smooth perfectly round black featureless stickman head, a tiny cyan-white eye slit, slender black limbs visible between futuristic armor pieces. Tall elegant threatening silhouette. Dark midnight-indigo and deep violet segmented armor, pale gold trim, luminous cyan-white chest star core, a thin broken orbital halo behind the round head. Two small floating crescent blade satellites beside shoulders, short divided dark cape. Holds a long luminous crescent-ended energy glaive, not a sword. Sophisticated space-station ruler, dramatic readable shape at small game size. No feather wings, no human face, no broad bodybuilder anatomy. All 16 poses exactly same armor, weapon and identity.
Composition: square image, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND FOUR ROWS, 16 equal cells in row-major order. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body boss with entire weapon, halo, cape, satellites and feet inside that cell with substantial transparent padding. All characters face LEFT or left three-quarter view. Same scale and central anchor across poses; tall standing pose fills no more than 75 percent of the cell. True transparent alpha background everywhere outside the sprites, no ground, no shadows outside sprites, no frame borders, no grid lines, no captions.
Frame order:
Row 1: 0 idle vigilant standing with glaive angled low; 1 running stride A; 2 running stride B; 3 running stride C.
Row 2: 4 deep crouch gathering energy; 5 glaive raised overhead windup; 6 powerful leftward glaive slash extension; 7 slash follow-through leaning forward.
Row 3: 8 compact crouch launch; 9 airborne ascent knees tucked weapon raised; 10 descending glaive pointed down cape flared; 11 hard landing crouch glaive grounded.
Row 4: 12 casting preparation left hand gathering a small cyan star orb; 13 casting release left hand outstretched, glaive held back; 14 hurt recoil torso pulled back; 15 exhausted recover stance with weapon low.
Style: polished painterly dimensional game sprite with metal shading and cyan edge light, strong clean black silhouette, fine controlled pale-gold detailing. Keep cells strictly separate and ample margins. No text, no watermark, no opaque backdrop, no colored checkerboard.
assets.refinementPrompt:
Refine the attached Astral Regent transparent animation sheet for actual sprite extraction. Keep exactly the same character identity, indigo-violet armor, cyan glaive, gold details, halo, crescent satellites and the same 16 animation poses in the same row-major order.
CRITICAL FIX: redraw EVERY pose substantially SMALLER inside its own equal cell. Use an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows grid with equal cells. EVERY character including the whole weapon, trailing cape, feet, halo, detached blades and all cyan glow MUST fit inside the CENTRAL 66 PERCENT OF ITS OWN CELL, leaving at least 17 percent EMPTY TRANSPARENT PADDING at EVERY edge. It is absolutely necessary to visibly reduce all sprites so they have generous empty margins. No pose may touch or cross a grid boundary. No neighboring sprite fragments in any cell. Entire feet and cape visible, no square cutoffs. Restrict weapon glows to thin close rims; no extended smoke or floating magic effects. Standing pose feet at 81 percent of its cell height and round head at 22 percent, horizontal body anchor 55 percent. Airborne poses also entirely within the same central safe region.
Keep all four rows and all four columns and the previous sequence: idle, run A, run B, run C; crouch windup, overhead weapon windup, left horizontal slash, slash follow-through; jump compress, ascending leap, descending leap, landing crouch; spell prepare, spell release, hurt, recovery. Each pose keeps complete full body and weapon. Same scale across all frames, clean alpha, transparent background, no ground or borders or text. This is a production sprite sheet, safety margins are more important than making the characters large.
